title: Total variation distance on the two-point space
statement:
Let $\mu$ and $\nu$ be probability measures on the two-point space $\mathrm{Bool} = \{\mathrm{true}, \mathrm{false}\}$. Then their total variation distance is the absolute difference of the masses they assign to the single point $\mathrm{true}$:
\[
\mathrm{TV}(\mu,\nu) = \abs{\mu(\{\mathrm{true}\}) - \nu(\{\mathrm{true}\})}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: μ and ν are probability measures on Bool
μ, ν are measures on the two-element type Bool
